label: Brain_Mass_excl_olfactory_bulb (g)
note: A weighed brain mass that the source states EXCLUDES the olfactory bulbs (Herculano-Houzel 2015, Kazu 2014/2015, Avelino-de-Souza 2025). Runs ~7% below Brain_Mass_measured on the 25 species that have both; not poolable with it.

label: Brain_Mass_mass_or_volume (g)
note: Compilations whose values are a weighed mass for some species and a volume converted at 1 cm3 = 1 g for others, with no per-row flag saying which (Burger 2019; Herculano-Houzel 2015 'brain.mass..g.or.cm3.'). Widest coverage in the app, but the basis is unresolved per species - treat as mass-or-volume, not as mass.

label: Brain_size_sum_of_structures (g)
note: A whole-brain figure obtained by summing 14 measured sub-structures INCLUDING the olfactory bulbs (Kverkova 2018), not a weighed whole brain.

label: Endocranial_volume (mL)
note: Capacity of the braincase: brain PLUS meninges, cerebrospinal fluid and vessels, so it exceeds brain volume. Cranial capacity is not brain weight and is never converted to mass here. Both-sexes or unspecified species means only.

label: Endocranial_volume_female (mL)
note: Female-only endocranial volume means (Caspar 2022; Powell 2017 rows labelled 'fem'). Kept apart from the both-sexes means because the two are different quantities in a dimorphic clade.

label: Brain_Mass_from_volume_or_ecv (g)
note: Not a weighed mass. Weaver 2001 computes it from a measured brain volume (extant species) or from an endocranial volume via Ruff et al. 1997 (fossils), so it is not poolable with Brain_Mass_measured and is not the same as the mass-or-volume compilations, which do weigh some species.
